info.comparison_title: Leave blank to use the product title
info.comparison_image: Shows above the column. Leave blank to use the product's featured image
info.comparison_points: One point per line. Used when the product has no comparison points, or when product points are turned off
info.use_product_points: Columns show each product's Comparison points metafield when it's filled, so the same wording appears on the collection page
